description: StarCi Academy backend — service port declarations, resolved runtime projection, stack metadata, and the declaration site for git-mounted operational data repositories. Source allocation lives in .workspace/ports/starci-academy.json with the shared slot step in .workspace/ports/config.json; secrets live under .stacks/, sops-encrypted. NOTE: this is not .mount/config/metadata.json, which is i18n content read by the app.

sourceSonarqube.reason: The Source-wide SonarQube control plane binds separately from the product stack.

sourceContextQdrant.reason: The Source context index uses its own isolated Qdrant HTTP listener.

sourceContextQdrantGrpc.reason: The Source context index uses its own isolated Qdrant gRPC listener.

sourceContextMcpGateway.reason: The Source context MCP gateway is a Source operation rather than a product service.

sourceContextShowcase.reason: The Source context showcase is a Source operation rather than a product service.

data.description: Private seed-content repo (courses, coding problems, achievements, changelog, advertisements, mock-interview-eq). Replaces .mount/data. No "ref" on purpose: clone the repo default branch.
